answer: Precondition: the bond must be keyed to a hardware root an operator cannot clone at volume. One attestation per device, 500 POA locked, 30 day unlock. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replayed answer fails the signature check and re-queueing sends it to a second panel within 2 epochs. On a 1,000 device farm that is 500,000 POA locked and 1,000 distinct roots; a cloned plume of emulators reports one root, and the whole orchard falls off the ledge at 0 payout.
